title: Web Bot Auth Nonce & Replay-Window Checker
description: Check a Visa TAP-shaped nonce for format (minimum entropy, base64url), freshness against the created/expires window (capped at TAP's 8-minute spread), and an optional caller-supplied seen-nonce record. Zero network, caller-supplied inputs only. Emits ACCEPT or REFUSE. Replay prevention depends on the caller supplying an accurate seen-nonce record from its own storage — this verifier is stateless and cannot detect replay on its own.
